a: Budgets and durations vary. 26-523 as a whole: about 300 awards, $180M total, subject to funds.
dt: NSF 26-523 (posted 2026-08-17) accepts proposals anytime; program page says 'Full proposal accepted anytime'. NSF urges submitting ahead of program target dates to hit a panel cycle.
e: PIs at eligible US institutions; unaffiliated individuals cannot apply. Covers high-energy (ATLAS/CMS), precision, and tools-for-particle-physics subareas. Talk to the program officers (J. Shank, K. De) first.
n: NSF MPS Physics: Elementary Particle Physics - Experiment (EPP-Experiment)
unv: No EPP-specific target date posted as of 2026-09-28; program page still cites the replaced NSF 23-615
